verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing page claims customer screening for onboarding, ongoing monitoring and ad-hoc investigations [hummingbird-docs-23], and its CRM profiles hold associated files for subjects [hummingbird-docs-8]. That is only a glancing nod to screening entities. Nothing documents business-entity-specific screening or any view of linked beneficial-ownership or association risk. Missing for 10: documented business/legal-entity screening, beneficial ownership or relationship graph inspection, linked-party risk context, and any first-party docs or independent corroboration beyond a marketing line.
